subject: Brightline SDK launch: telemetry, retry/backoff and rate-smoothing plan
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin@brightline.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightline Integrations <integrations@brightline.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff -> CSM -> Implementation handoff (Brightline)

Hi Monica —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and our platform team are ready to move to the implementation phase. We want to confirm the handoff plan for the SDK integration, telemetry expectations, and how to handle spikes during launch (retries/timeouts and rate-limits).

High-level asks:
- A short runbook for devs covering SDK setup + sample snippet for tokenized calls.
- Recommended timeout/retry/backoff defaults for our traffic profile (bursty during morning syncs).
- Telemetry events we should expect from Redwood (latency, token counts, errors) and how to surface them in our monitoring.

I've attached the integration spec and a CSV of expected daily calls. Procurement is cc'd to coordinate contract logistics.

Can your team propose a 2-week onboarding runway with checkpoints (sandbox signoff -> staging -> prod cutover)?

— Erin
Senior Platform Engineer, Brightline Labs

Attachment: brightline-integration-spec-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 420 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Walsh <erin@brightline.com>, Brightline Integrations <integrations@brightline.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff -> CSM -> Implementation handoff (Brightline)

Thanks Erin — looping in the implementation squad. Vivek, Chloe, Kimberly: Brightline is requesting a practical, developer-friendly integration playbook focused on SDK setup, sample code, endpoint migration, and robust retry/backoff defaults for a bursty profile.

Proposed initial plan (2-week runway):
1) Day 0–2: Sandbox access, share SDK examples, run the smoke snippet (we provide).
2) Day 3–6: Staging integration, telemetry verification (latency, token counts, error labels), and load tests at 2x expected peak.
3) Day 7–10: Address any throttle/retry tuning; agree SLOs for p95 latency and token cost targets.
4) Day 11–14: Prod cutover window and rollback criteria.

Deliverables we'll provide this week: SDK bundle with sample snippets, a one-page retry/timeout recommendation card, and a telemetry mapping sheet.

Erin — is Brightline's staging reachable over the public internet or do we need a private peering/VPC setup? That affects how we suggest keepalive and connection timeouts.

Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Walsh <erin@brightline.com>
Date: 2027-10-21T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff -> CSM -> Implementation handoff (Brightline)

Quick clarifying q's from the integration side:
- Traffic shape: Erin, when you say "bursty during morning syncs", can you share 15-minute peak per-minute request rate and average request size (tokens)?
- Are you planning to use streaming for long responses, or single-shot generation?
- Any on-prem constraints (e.g., outbound-only, no TLS termination) we should know about?

From a technical standpoint we'll:
- Provide an SDK with both sync (blocking) and async (streaming) examples.
- Default connection timeouts: 5s connect, 45s read; recommend retry with jittered exponential backoff capped at 8s for idempotent requests.
- For rate-limits: suggest adaptive client-side leaky-bucket + server side 429 handling with Retry-After. We'll include a sample middleware for commons SDK languages.

I'll draft the telemetry mapping (fields + event names) and attach it to the staging checklist.

—Chloe
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Erin Walsh <erin@brightline.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-25T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff -> CSM -> Implementation handoff (Brightline)

This looks great — thanks for the quick turn, team. A few answers to Chloe's questions:
- Peak 15-min window: ~1,200 reqs/min at peak; average tokens per request ~320.
- We'll start with single-shot generation; streaming may come later for long-form.
- Staging is public but behind an allowlist; we'll add the Redwood staging IPs.

Action items agreed:
- Monica: share the sandbox invite and staging allowlist by EOD Friday (10/22).
- Vivek: finalize the SDK tarball with the middleware and Prometheus mapping.
- Chloe: produce the telemetry mapping doc and the retry recommendation card.
- Brightline: we'll run 2x peak load during staging tests next Wednesday (10/27) and share results.

Procurement: please find me if you need formal statements for the SOW; we can attach the integration spec to the purchase request.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

— Erin
Senior Platform Engineer, Brightline Labs
